facts.text: Pack the coconuts and the taro, Pua. It's a long paddle tonight, and Maui keeps pinching the fish before it's cooked.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Moana's words, but she never says it. It also gets the plot wrong: Maui is not on the canoe at the start of the film, he has been captured by Matangi and Moana's crew is Loto, Moni, Kele, Pua and Heihei. I could not open a quote page for this pass (the search tool was out of budget), so there is no quote source.
facts.fix: Pack the coconuts and the taro, Pua. Long paddle tonight, and keep Heihei away from the fish.
